name: AnatoEIT
description: Synthetic benchmark and reconstruction code accompanying the manuscript ‘AnatoEIT: Reusable CT–EIT Fusion for Volumetric Pulmonary Imaging with Quantified Prior-Mismatch Limits’. The deposit contains an independent 328-channel nonlinear finite-element benchmark, separate forward and inverse discretizations, frozen parameters for five reconstruction methods, mode-adaptive prior-mismatch and crossover records, CT-AGS ablations, and non-clinical source data for the reported figures and tables. Clinical CT and EIT data are excluded because unrestricted redistribution is not authorized by the approvals and participant-consent terms.
